sentences.text: Constellate computed a modest symptom similarity between alpha-mannosidosis and GM1 gangliosidosis, with a score of 0.231 over 23 shared terms, ranked 5 of 5 [e_b901a7f62bf3].
This link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_b901a7f62bf3].

The causes differ: alpha-mannosidosis is curated as caused by MAN2B1, while GM1 gangliosidosis is linked to GLB1 only by an inferred roll-up from subtypes at confidence 0.475 [e_d7440f028524] [e_4b6a2b49884c].

GM1 gangliosidosis has two studies on ClinicalTrials.gov, a prenatal gene transfer study not yet recruiting and a recruiting study of an oral drug called nizubaglustat [e_c96cb9bc9690] [e_2002d33295d6].
A research grant for an AAV approach to this condition is also recorded, and a patient group link comes from unverified text mining [e_d8e337b6892d] [e_b7708b486598].
For alpha-mannosidosis, curated records list low alpha-mannosidase activity and underdeveloped hip bones [e_8af58477461f] [e_8b3615af8861].
These edges do not show that the GM1 gangliosidosis studies apply to alpha-mannosidosis, and they do not show that any drug works [e_b901a7f62bf3] [e_c96cb9bc9690] [e_2002d33295d6].
